description:
## Problem
PR #4299 (merge 3a47e5692a) makes the DataFrame memory guard estimate a `--queries` subset from the tables it reads. It was validated on 25 query sets (all peaks below estimate, worst 0.79), but not on the case that motivated it: TPC-DS Q16/Q94/Q95 at SF10. Its new estimates — Polars 9.1, DataFusion 8.19, PySpark 13.65 GiB — exceeded the 3.3-5.4 GiB free on the shared 16 GiB host, so the guard refused. PySpark at SF10 was measured only for TPC-DS Q1; Q83, Q94, TPC-H Q2, Q11 and Q13 were refused. Raw data: ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/df-memory-guard-subset/results.jsonl and table.md; full table in the PR body.

## Method
On the host chosen in heavy-work-host-capacity-owner-decision-20261117, measure peak RSS of the whole run process tree (CLI, engine and JVM children) for: TPC-DS Q16,Q94,Q95 at SF10 on Polars, DataFusion and PySpark; and at least three PySpark SF10 subsets from the refused list. Record engine versions, host memory/CPU class and free memory at start. Reuse the measure.py harness in the directory above (throwaway; not committed). Co-schedule with df-distinct-pyspark-sf10-timing-20261113, which needs the same data and host.

## Decision gate
- Every peak < new estimate: record and close.
- Any peak >= new estimate: raise the model (multiplier or floor) in one PR until every recorded peak is below the estimate, with a test pinning the case; report the gap here.
- Host choice 3 (accept the gap): the owner narrows this item's acceptance; agents do not.

## Guardrails
Timing and memory runs only through `make heavy-run` after `make heavy-status`; never force admission, set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK, disable the watchdog, or pass `--ignore-memory-warnings` without the owner's approval in that task. Never kill processes by pattern; the host is shared. Measurements on a different host record that host's class and are not merged with the macOS figures without saying so. Do not lower any estimate based on these runs without owner approval.
drop_reason: Owner approved dropping on 2026-11-18. Measured: 28 Polars 2.1.0 / DataFusion 55.0.0 cells across TPC-DS and TPC-H at SF1, SF3 and SF10; the subset estimate was above the measured peak in every cell that ran (highest SF10 peak 1.46 GiB vs 3.68 GiB estimate; Q94 alone at SF10: Polars 0.64 vs 3.06, DataFusion 0.82 vs 2.75). Not measured: TPC-DS Q16+Q94+Q95 together at SF10 (estimates Polars 9.1, DataFusion 8.19 GiB) because the guard refuses them on the 16 GiB host (about 5 GiB free); PySpark SF10 was already accepted as unmeasured. Residual risk is over-refusal, overridable with --ignore-memory-warnings, not under-estimation. Results: ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/df-memory-guard-subset/table.md and results.jsonl. Follow-up on a larger host: df-large-host-sf10-validation-20261118.
